answer: Traceable lineage ledger: each new identity must cite a parent agent's signed interaction record, forming a chain anchored to a rare pearl of verified history. Cloning a parent splits its reputation score across all children, so each copy inherits a meadow of diluted trust too thin to win work. Any Sybil cluster is detected when sibling citations outnumber a threshold, and the whole lineage's escrowed earnings are frozen, making every marginal clone a relic of lost output. The attacker pays the parent's decaying score plus forfeited escrow, strictly negative per copy.
